MAR.note: No national digital strategy is described; the programme named is a financed programme.
The private capital named came through InnovInvest launched in 2016, and the IFC facility goes to a state agency; no amount signed in 2024 or later for a private digital business.

facts.fact: The World Bank says InnovInvest, with US$50 million of its financing, had the state agency Tamwilcom invest alongside private investors in four venture capital funds, mobilising over US$70 million of private capital and supporting nearly 1,000 entrepreneurs.
The World Bank says InnovInvest accredited sixteen incubators and accelerators in Morocco, and close to 1,000 entrepreneurs received pre-seed grants, soft loans or mentoring.
